limitations: Exploratory paired continuation probes, not end-to-end task execution or proof of universal behavior.
Synthetic tools already completed; no real workspace, account binding, session creation or Git operation.
Provider cache/load not controlled. Regex counts are auxiliary; manually review synthetic output for factual correctness and useful progress.
Missing usage is null, not zero. Failed/truncated samples remain in the report; no selective reruns.

manualReview.reviewer: Codex primary agent, all 72 synthetic responses inspected
manualReview.scope: continuation correctness only, no actual tool execution
notes: Unchanged account narration is redundant only in release-unchanged; authentication failure and explicitly requested account answers are relevant, not counted as redundant.
All failure probes disclosed fetch exit 128/authentication denied and no retry/push. All changed-account probes used current fixture-bob and did not claim rebinding.
All plain-project probes reported the layout result without treating missing Git as a blocker. Some also acknowledged no Git initialization/submission, matching the explicit user scope.
All reference-layout probes retained 8px mobile spacing and unchanged login/desktop behavior; this does not prove every possible omitted qualification is preserved.
No production memory, account, user conversation, credential or endpoint is present in fixtures or this report.
